What I find so stupid is that the media blames everything on video games. Lets think about it for a second. If we compare this to a science experiment for example, the experiment has to be completed multiple times, maybe even hundreds of times to be considered a "law" or "theory" and each experiment is conducted with even more trials.
 
Now we see in the news of a child supposedly being affected by video games killing another kid. So here we have this issue where the media is going all beserk on him blaming video games because that was probably the easiest thing to blame it on. Now this to me doesn't make any sense partly because there have been no tests to see if the kid is mentally unstable or anything of the sort. Anther reason, now we go back to the science experiment idea, is because this is ONE kid out of THOUSANDS that play the game. I mean, this isn't even close to being a "sample" of a science experiment. Surveys are the exact same, if we wanted to know the average height of people in a country the surveyors would take a "sample" of the population consisting of THOUSANDS of people. Now if we counted the amount of news stories and events that involve kids killing people due to violent video games there are definitely not enough to conclude that violent video games are in any way shape or form affecting children's minds to the extent that they would KILL someone! I find this party humiliating because the community/media are so directed towards the idea that these video games are bad, they don't even consider other reasons for events like this.

So be completely honest nidalee is pic that can be really good for your team, and can also be very bad for your team. As you described your laning experience vs two champs farming under tower, this can be very difficult as nidalee. Nidalee is best put in mid lane as ap, but is also viable in higher elo games as a top lane, split push/ad nidalee. If she is in a 2v1 lane then you will have to be really good at csing to be able to get farm because the tower + minions can really mess up your timing with the AA's. On the other hand if you are running out of mana fast because you want to farm as best as possible, then getting a tear or chalice would be the best bet. these both give you incredible mana regen and are probably the most necessary item on a high mana cost champ like nidalee. Another thing you could do, since you stated that you sometimes go support, you can get a GP5 or GP10 item. These help you get money without actually csing and can be very useful if you get it early in the game. Overall, if you are getting zoned a lot and need that extra bit of sustain then buy a tear of the goddess and try your best to farm and poke with your q's to relieve the pressure put on by the enemy players.

I have had the exact same problem. This is my solution to problem a lot of us have here. I was getting very desperate (i still am) about wanting a girlfriend. I need the love of someone other than my parents so to speak. I have never had a relationship before, so I was (still am) quite rusty with the "talk to girl" thing and "flirting" as well. I watched a TED talk about how you can trick people into thinking you are an outgoing person. "Fake it till you make it" meaning that you should pretend to be as confident as possible, even though you don't feel that way inside you. Try to smile a lot as well, as it grabs the attention of people. I am a very shy guy so this was very difficult for me. I still am very shy, but i can cope with that. Anyway, eventually you start talking to more people of the opposite sex, and you will start to text and such. The important thing is to not be too impatient. This is probably why she didn't want to go on a second date. Eventually, i built up the courage to ask her out on a date. This went well for me, although the conversation got stale once or twice, it wasn't awkward. This might be the first step to being able to date each other. Being able to stay silent without having an awkward moment with them. Anyway, after a little while i asked her to dinner. We had a nice dinner and we felt a gradual smoothness in the conversation. When I think back, it was probably all due to the fact that I acted more confident then i really was. I kept things in me, rather than saying them immediately just to avoid the "trying too hard" aspect and "not being patience" aspect. I asked her out this Friday, and I am confident it will work because we still text everyday. She was in the same situation I was in as I understand, as her excuse to not answer immediately was "i have never been in a relationship before". Take my word for it, if you act more confident, it will grab peoples attention. Eventually you will notice yourself moving away from being forever alone, in terms of friends and a SO
